Gold is investment insurance because it's always worth something, not necessarily something in which you expect huge gains in relation to fiat currency.

When the economy tanks, the value of everything may briefly plummet, because if no one has any money to spend, the demand (in the sense of "ability to buy", not "desire to buy") for everything will drop to zero, so prices will have to drop to compensate before reaching a new equilibrium.

The upshot of this is that if you've got real money like gold and silver, it'll be an amazing opportunity to BTFD.

If you are buying precious metals for a prepping situation, you shouldn't be selling unless your currency can no longer buy what you need. These market trends shouldn't influence you unless you are speculative trading.
